g.text: Mmm. We see You're the type that likes to shake the little magnetic toy and give things another go-around, aren't You?
sorry, no. instruments. i forget that most people don't eat, breathe, and bleed music like i do
That's all right... We'll play along... We love a good game of... pretend... ;)
Well! Funny thing You should ask about that...
heh. yeah. sorry. forgot that most people don't eat, breathe, and bleed music like i do
I... wouldn't call it playing. I try, but I'm not very good at it. It's called a shawzin.
I do. It's called a shawzin.
because You are just so sticky sweet, aren't You? We could just Eat You Right Up...
It was going just wonderfully until YOU arrived into OUR lives
Ready to just BUGGER everything up
i'd say if you got bored i'd teach you but i'm afraid she'd get jealous and
I'm not liking where this is going. I'm ending this now. [End.]
Last I checked, I was here saving people.
I'm sorry? What did I do?
hey, at least you try, credit where credit's due. that's more than most people
go ahead, run away if You want to, there's no escaping Us
LEARN TO STAY OUT OF OTHER PEOPLE'S BUSINESS, SUGAR
what kind of instrument is a shawzin? stringed? wind? percussion?
We'll pick this up another time, won't We
Who are you talking about when you say "we?"
Goooood... then maybe We will get along after all...
Ssh... not what We are here for. We have a Question.
rad. maybe we could jam together someday
Not every Princess in a Castle wants to be Saved from their Dragon, isn't that right, mmmm?
I probably have a spare shawzin kicking around if you want one.
I just learned electric guitars exist, hearing them mixed with a shawzin will be wild.
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank2Convo1.
Though some of Us are the Dragon, aren't we? Ahahahaaaaa
wonderful. i love mixing styles, that's where the magic happens. i got real hard into super twangy country music for a few
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank2Convo1.
Mmm. Did you know some cultures only have one word for both Demon and Dragon? Funny, that....
i... that's... really thoughtful, but... please don't...
talking the real deal, deep woods, back country, slide guitar 'n moonshine shit
she and i never really totally got on, sad to say. never held it against her, though
Who are You playing in OUR story, Sugar?
do you know how hard it is to be a 5'-1 tall woman in rock'n'roll? and to be a drummer no less?
I've already lived through one storybook. I'm not interested in another.
that lady was only happy when she had a needle in her arm or a head between her legs
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank2Convo1.
angriest thing i've ever met in my life
OoOooOoh after Our Own Heart!! Villains are So Much More Juicy, aren't They?
No Choice is a Choice. Haven't You Learned that Yet?! APATHY IS A VOID THAT SCREAMS YOUR NAME.
Without all that Prickly MORALITY to get Stuck in Our Teeth... So from One Demon to Another...
but VERY WELL. IIIIF YOU don't want to answer Our question, so be it... Choose Your Own Path for now...
We will give You fair warning... This one BELONGS TO US. They are NOT YOURS.
But Hero Beware... This one belongs to US. They are not YOURS!!
We have Our own means of digging into Your Insides and chewing the marrow from Your bones yet...
she was one of those folks who couldn't stand people who couldn't be honest
either with themselves or the world around them
Kisses, Sugar.... Ta Taaaa for now.... ;)
sorry. way more than you ever needed to hear
Quiet, Villain. Be Good For Us. Just Once.
Sssh Villain... You'll Learn. Soon Enough.
Silly Little Hero... You'll learn... You'll Learn Soon Enough...
Mmmmm.... We could get used to that.
Mmmmm.... We could get used to that.
Vent away. We've all lost people.
I don't mind. Have you talked to Eleanor? I've heard worse.
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank2Convo1.
and wish we'd lose one more... though she's hardly "people" is she...
i... haven't gone near her, no
If it's the tongue thing or the telepathy thing...
it's... it's complicated, and i'd rather not talk about it... i'm sure she's quite charming but it has nothing to do with her
i - i just - i'm sorry. this isn't my fault please understand
Okay. If you're not comfortable talking, I'll wait until you are.
Flare, seriously. I can tell something's wrong. You can talk to me.
i - i just - i'm sorry. this isn't my fault please understand
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank2Convo1.
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank2Convo1.
